Name: Mod Uploader
Description:
[h1]Release your mods from a script.[/h1]
For modders. It adds nothing to the game: it uploads your mods to the Steam Workshop, and to mod.io, from a file instead of the game's upload panel.

[h2]How it works[/h2]
Write a request file in your Timberborn folder and open the game. At the main menu, Mod Uploader reads it, uploads the mod and writes the outcome to a result file. A release script can start the game, wait for the result and close it again.

[list]
[*]The request can set the title, description, changelog, preview image, visibility and tags. What it leaves out stays as the panel's last upload left it.
[*]mod.io is optional. Add a zip to the request and keep an access token with write access in a file, and it uploads there too.
[*]Required items: a small file lists Workshop items to add as required items of a mod after each upload, which the panel can't do.
[/list]

[h2]Before you use it[/h2]
[list]
[*]The first upload of a mod still goes through the game's panel, which creates the Workshop item.
[*]Steam has to be running and signed in.
[/list]

[h2]Format and source[/h2]
The request file's format and a sample release script are in the source: [url=https://github.com/FezVrasta/TimberbornModUploader]github.com/FezVrasta/TimberbornModUploader[/url]
